title: DICTO: Collected Geometric Works
description:
DICTO is a geometric sculptor in Osaka whose work grows out of building with recycled PET and from three open apps on one shared geometry: Kaleidohedra, Rhombiverse and Polyhedraverse. This record gathers DICTO's published geometry under one DOI. Each work has its own DICTO DOI, always pointing to its latest version; the numbers are those of DICTO's findings on dictospheres.com.

Version 17 adds #40, The DICTO OG Family on Every Stacking, and #39, The DICTO OG Family: Four Steps Up and Four Down, and lists Version 3 of #38 (new figures, and the prior art for its rule) and Version 4 of #37a (it is the DICTO Jewel's packing, not the solid, that does not twin); Version 16 listed the Version 3 updates of #37a (the DICTO Octahedrally Truncated Triacontahedron and the DICTO Fill sets) and #31a (the OCD Stella's crystals); Version 15 added #37a, The DICTO Ogdoecontahedron on the Gyrated Octet; Version 14 added #38a, The DICTO Kepler–Poinsot–UP Cycle, and recorded that from 20 October 2026 every paper listed here is released under CC BY-SA 4.0 (Attribution-ShareAlike): each has a new version with that licence, and earlier versions keep CC BY 4.0. Version 13 added #38, Universal PiTet: The DICTO PiTet Proposition; Version 12 added #37, The DICTO Ogdoecontahedron on the Octet Truss; Version 11 added #36, Golden Bodhi Pyrochlore; Version 10 corrected the paper count and named the seven findings published with the app; Version 9 added #34a, The DICTO Hecatogdoecontahedron, and #31a, The DICTO OCD Stella; Version 8 added #35b; Version 7 #35a; Version 6 #35; Version 5 #34.
